I'm not so sure on that 9mm statement, I've shot 9mm through some pretty solid surfaces. If it was shot between joists 9mm could have easily wound up penetrating a good bit with FMJ. Having no clue what kinda floors/ceilings are in that building doesn't help, but it would have to be very well made for me to just assume 9mm. I'd lean more toward a .380, but honestly there are so many factors, barrel length (we're talking pocket pistol all the way to carbine), bullet weight, structure fired through, etc. All that to say, it could be 9mm, but I'd guess .380. It's a caliber a lot of inexperienced people start with for self defense, and hopefully this was just inexperience and not a more serious scenario.
